notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 4.
description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying six {B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to exile all but the bottom six cards of their library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
When Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to win the game.
